description: This file defines a class OperatingSystem under the namespace SuiteCRM\Utility. It provides methods to detect the OS type (BSD, Linux, MacOSX, Solaris, Unknown, Windows) and a method to convert file paths to the operating system's path format.

classes.name: OperatingSystem
classes.description: A utility class for detecting the operating system and converting file paths accordingly.

methods.name: isOsBSD
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is BSD.

methods.name: isOsLinux
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Linux.

methods.name: isOsMacOSX
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Mac OS X (Darwin).

methods.name: isOsSolaris
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Solaris.

methods.name: isOsUnknown
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Unknown.

methods.name: isOsWindows
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Windows.

methods.name: toOsPath
methods.description: Converts a given path string to the format appropriate for the current operating system.
